mechanism: Detection and occupancy vary with depth band within a guild preferred vertical range; depth is recorded on the completed dive.
depth_relevance: primary predictor for benthic and reef visual surveys; surface-only for pelagic if only skin depth is known
notes: Present on retained Atlantic RVC/NCRMP event tables; used in internal survey-only baselines. Not an external ocean product.

mechanism: Optical detectability rises with clearer water; low visibility suppresses visual detections without proving absence.
depth_relevance: applies to the surveyed optical depth band of the dive or camera
notes: Observer-recorded on RVC dives; detection-process covariate, not fish density.

mechanism: Local structural habitat class conditions which reef and demersal guilds are available to detect.
depth_relevance: station-scale; not a continuous depth model
notes: RVC HABITAT_CD is dive-observed; not a remote reef map. Catalogued in audit/habitat as RVC_HABITAT_CD.

mechanism: Complex hard substrate increases shelter and encounter rates for reef-associated fishes; flat soft bottom does not substitute.
depth_relevance: benthic contact zone and near-bottom water column over structure
notes: Rugosity grids and licensed reef-habitat maps are not in this repo. GEBCO bathymetry was not downloaded. Do not invent a rugosity dataset ID.

mechanism: Metabolic and distribution constraints for demersal and deep guilds track temperature at the occupied depth not skin SST alone.
depth_relevance: must match occupied depth; surface SST is a weak proxy for deep demersal bands
notes: No depth-resolved temperature product acquired. MUR SST is surface analysed SST only.

mechanism: Hypoxia and oxygen minimum zones exclude or concentrate demersal and mesopelagic fishes at preferred oxygen levels.
depth_relevance: depth-resolved; surface oxygen is not a substitute for OMZ or bottom hypoxia
notes: No oxygen profile or bottom-oxygen archive verified in this repo.

mechanism: Soft mud/sand versus rock/gravel selects demersal soft vs rocky guilds and gear/survey detectability.
depth_relevance: seafloor interface
notes: Only survey habitat codes are present locally. Continuous substrate maps not acquired.

mechanism: Surface thermal habitat and fronts can shift coastal and oceanic pelagic encounter rates; relevance is guild-dependent and often weak for deep demersal or reef bottom dwellers.
depth_relevance: skin/near-surface; poor proxy for deep demersal bottom temperature
notes: Verified dataset ID in repo manifests: jplMURSST41 (NOAA CoastWatch ERDDAP / JPL MUR). Small Keys box and current snippet exist; not joined to survey events. Not universal across guilds.

mechanism: Salinity gradients structure estuarine mangrove and diadromous distributions and can mark coastal fronts for some pelagics.
depth_relevance: surface/near-surface; subsurface salinity needed for deep guilds
notes: WCOFS and Copernicus are named candidates in audit catalogs but were not acquired. No salinity product ID verified as downloaded here.

mechanism: Proxy for phytoplankton biomass and trophic energy; may correlate with coastal pelagic and some estuarine encounter rates not with deep-sea occupancy.
depth_relevance: optical surface layer; not mesopelagic or deep-sea food webs directly
notes: Copernicus chlorophyll class listed as ACCOUNT_ACTION_REQUIRED / not acquired. Do not invent a chlorophyll dataset ID.

mechanism: Fronts eddies and alongshore transport concentrate or advect coastal and oceanic pelagics; weak direct mechanism for sessile reef detections.
depth_relevance: surface/upper ocean
notes: WCOFS temperature/salinity/currents/ssh named as CANDIDATE and not subset. RTOFS forecast search returned HTTP 404; no forecast grid saved.

mechanism: Reduces visual and optical detectability; can also mark river plume habitat for estuarine and mangrove-associated fishes.
depth_relevance: photic zone of the survey method
notes: Not acquired as a gridded product. Survey visibility is the local optical field on RVC dives.

mechanism: Tidal exchange moves estuarine and mangrove fishes and changes accessible depth and salinity on short timescales.
depth_relevance: intertidal to shallow subtidal
notes: No tide product verified in this repo for model joins.

mechanism: Discharge sets estuarine salinity and nursery habitat volume for diadromous and estuarine life stages.
depth_relevance: surface to estuarine mixing depth
notes: Not acquired in this repo.

mechanism: Controls diel vertical position and visual foraging for mesopelagic and many reef fishes; interacts with time of day.
depth_relevance: depth-attenuated light field
notes: No PAR/light product acquired. Time-of-day alone is an incomplete proxy.

variable_name: local solar time or sun elevation
mechanism: Diel behavior (foraging sheltering vertical migration) changes detection probability by hour within a region and guild.
depth_relevance: interacts with depth for DVM guilds
notes: Not a fitted behavior model. Useful only with explicit region and guild scope.

mechanism: Sets available depth habitat and slope; must not be confused with fish presence.
depth_relevance: full water-column context
notes: GEBCO listed in habitat catalog as not downloaded. Bathymetry alone is not reef-presence evidence.

variable_name: depth of oxygen minimum or OMZ intensity
mechanism: Mesopelagic and deep-sea vertical distributions often track OMZ boundaries.
depth_relevance: mesopelagic to bathypelagic bands
notes: No OMZ product verified in this repo.

mechanism: Structural nursery and foraging habitat for seagrass-associated fishes and some juvenile stages of other guilds.
depth_relevance: shallow photic bottoms
notes: No seagrass map product verified as acquired here.

mechanism: Juvenile nursery association for mangrove-linked life stages; adult reef phases may use different predictors.
depth_relevance: intertidal to shallow subtidal nursery band
notes: Nursery locations for sensitive taxa stay withheld. No mangrove grid acquired for training.

mechanism: Microhabitat and prey base for coral-associated fishes; distinct from hard-bottom alone.
depth_relevance: reef crest to deeper reef slope within photic limits
notes: May overlap RVC habitat coding at stations; continuous coral-cover maps not acquired.

mechanism: Candidate nowcast/forecast covariate only after as-of rules; guild relevance follows analysed SST and bottom-temperature caveats.
depth_relevance: product-dependent vertical levels
notes: WCOFS not subset; Copernicus no credentials; CoastWatch RTOFS search HTTP 404. No forecast grid in repo.
